article.headline: Brzovic, Boyd lead Charleston to 88-83 OT win over Elon
article.description: — Ante Brzovic scored 27 points and Derrin Boyd added six of his 24 points in the overtime as Charleston defeated Elon 88-83 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Brzovic, Boyd lead Charleston to 88-83 OT win over Elon
article.story: CHARLESTON, S.C -- — Ante Brzovic scored 27 points and Derrin Boyd added six of his 24 points in the overtime as Charleston defeated Elon 88-83 on Saturday night. Brzovic made the first of two free-throw attempts to force overtime tied 71-all. Boyd shot 1 of 2 from the field and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line in the extra period. Brzovic added 10 rebounds, five assists, and three steals for the Cougars (19-6, 9-3 Coastal Athletic Association). CJ Fulton had 14 points. Nick Dorn led the way for the Phoenix (15-10, 6-6) with 21 points, eight rebounds and two steals. Sam Sherry added 19 points and six rebounds for Elon. TK Simpkins finished with 17 points. Charleston entered halftime up 44-36. Brzovic paced the team in scoring in the first half with 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
